Native building material picker and statue captions, DF 53.16

Source images:
  ELF Steam: bcc6789e6fb477b785a2b02be80b8b1b054ff88c
  PE Classic: 6a70b91c / image size 0270a000
  native-image.tsv retains each file path and SHA-256.
  native-functions/calls/branches/switches/literals/data/virtuals.tsv retain
  complete procedures and operands. native-*.c is Ghidra decompilation;
  native-*.asm retains original instruction boundaries. PE jump/selector
  tables are data even where they lie inside a chained unwind extent.

The PE Classic renderer 37f1f0 corresponds to Steam RVA 381630 in the existing
native_pe_build_bindings.inc edition map. No Steam executable was present on
this Linux host. Steam title ca0b40 and item getter sources are also retained
in the existing item-info-title-sources.tsv and statue-art-sources.tsv. This
extraction reads the installed ELF and the locally available real Classic PE;
it does not label mapped addresses as a separately decompiled Steam image.

Picker renderer: ELF d84fd0..d87fb2 / PE Classic 37f1f0..38091d
  heading := "Select materials for the " BUILDING "."
  requirement := "Amount needed: " LOW (" to " HIGH)?
  search := native editable item filter and its empty/in-progress text
  footer := "Done"
  item row := NAME (SELECTED "/" AVAILABLE)? "Dist: " DISTANCE
  expandable group := GROUP_NAME (" [" GROUP_COUNT "]")? "Dist: " DISTANCE
  group children := complete item rows
  bulk selection action := "All"
  expand/collapse, selected ticks, +/- controls and quality/designation
  marks are native glyphs; they are not English words to translate.
  Availability determines enabled/disabled and highlight colors. Numeric
  amounts, names, distance and controls have independent native positions.
  Name clipping reserves columns according to the presence of a selection
  amount. The original complete string is the translation input, not "...".

Entry virtual dispatch:
  ELF +18 / PE +10 getName:
    build_req_choice_genst: actual item type/subtype/material, plural when
      number of candidates > 1; shared item-noun constructor supplies its
      optional bracketed group count.
    build_req_choice_specst: complete-item-name(item, article=false,
      count=-1); missing item gives literal "Null".
    build_req_choicest base: empty.
  Header BUILDING uses the existing complete building-name constructor,
  extracted in fortress-build-placement and the building-name source tables.

Complete item names: ELF e68020 / PE Classic c62490 (Steam c65450)
  Named artifacts select their native generated name, otherwise the item
  description remains. Book and writing branches can use TITLE " (copy)".
  Item flags select paired foreign/forbidden markers, sale designation,
  artifact markers, decoration quality and construction quality. Quality
  values select none, -, +, *, CP437 f0 (equivalent sign), CP437 0f (sun).
  Wear selects x, X or XX; these are case-sensitive. Article and quantity
  options are native arguments, not inferred from the capitalization.
  The item-specific description slot provides the complete material/item
  noun. Its existing runtime grammar handles every type, including nested
  statue and figurine subjects, corpse parts, containers and written titles.
  item-noun-constructor.c and its switch/literal source tables retain the
  complete type dispatch and default branches, not a statue-only subset.

Statue/figurine title: ELF e82910 / PE Classic c9db80 (Steam ca0b40)
  title := BASE_ITEM_NAME (" of " SAVED_SHORT_SUBJECT)?
  Empty saved subject omits " of ". An absent art reference invokes native
  initialization before the getter appends the saved string; translation
  reads the result and never invokes art-generation functions itself.
  Short subject generation uses only elements[0], if present:
    ELF 1857740 calls first element +48, definite=false.
    PE cc5510 inlines the equivalent first element +40 call, definite=false.
  This is separate from the full-art prose element formatter:
    ELF +40 / PE +38 getName;
    ELF +48 / PE +40 getShortName.
  Art properties/actions, historical events, design quality, artist and
  deity domains are not appended to the short subject by this operation.

All short subject types:
  Creature: if historical figure resolves and has a valid name, native name
    alone; otherwise singular/plural caste/species from that figure when
    available, or the element's own race/caste. Singular has "a "; definite
    mode has "the ". No numeric count or "NAME the SPECIES" in short mode.
  Item: linked named artifact returns its name alone. An unnamed artifact
    uses complete item description; applicable unnamed written items return
    "Untitled". Otherwise singular/plural material/item noun, with the same
    article convention. Inner item descriptions can include another statue.
  Plant and tree: singular/plural plant RAW NAME, with the article convention.
    The tree and plant functions differ in ELF and share a function in PE.
  Shape: singular/plural shape RAW noun, with the article convention. The
    short formatter overwrites the earlier adjective temporary with the noun;
    full-art prose owns the adjective. Invalid RAW indices preserve the
    native empty/article-only output rather than inventing a figure name.
  Base element: empty text. Empty first element does not advance to another
    element; no visible subject suffix is generated.

The long element routines are retained alongside these short routines to
preserve their distinct branches: named species, deity depiction and domains,
artifacts/items, shapes, plants, singular/plural and definite articles. Their
dynamic RAW/name/material/event sources already belong to the shared runtime
vocabularies and statue-description-grammar.md; they are not finite screenshot
spellings. Multiple-subject grammar remains supported for stored/custom art
strings, while the native short producer above selects one first element.

Translation ownership:
  native-display-fields.tsv identifies the actual name, selected amount,
  distance label and distance number call sites. Dist: and its numeric value
  are separate addst calls; a combined draw is not the native contract.
  fortress_build_placement.inc reads the name draw by its original return
  address before word matching, restores the complete pre-clipping name, and
  reserves the amount and distance columns. Header/panel/texture recognition
  and a shared logical layer are not prerequisites for this native role.
  native_caption_hooks.inc retains the actual visible draw even for width=0,
  preserving its original caller, clipping and unabridged source together.
  Unknown authored fields remain one complete field.
  item_descriptions.inc lets statue/figurine + subject productions run before
  the base-only ::items grammar. Shared material qualifiers and symbol/name
  resolvers translate the subject without introducing screenshot name aliases.
  local-overrides.tsv retains the requirement-range and missing-item texts.
  ELF name/amount/Dist returns are d87191, d87271, d874d6 and d8751d;
  PE Classic returns are 3802cf, 3803df, 38047e and 3804be. The existing PE
  edition map places them at Steam 38270f, 38281f, 3828be and 3828fe.
  Source coordinates are passed through each host's existing native address
  resolver; field ownership and translation remain shared by ELF and PE.

This is offline source reconstruction. No game window was operated or observed.
